en.commentary:
I have ranked portable SSDs by sequential read speed for years, and in 2026 that column stopped mattering. Price is now the only variable that moves week to week, so I rebuilt this list around dollars per terabyte and dated every figure. The numbers behind that decision are stark. A 1Tb TLC NAND die cost about $4.80 in July 2025 and runs roughly $10.70 today. A 2TB NVMe drive that sold for $175 in November 2025 hit $379 by March 2026. SanDisk repriced its entire line, some SKUs by 2.8x. The Samsung T9 1TB launched at $139.99 and now trades around $245. That is the same drive, same firmware, same box, at 1.75x the money.

So the Crucial X9 Pro takes first place, and it takes it on arithmetic. It holds about 1,050MB/s through a sustained 200GB write, wraps that in a steel shell rated for a 7.5-foot drop, and lands at the lowest cost per terabyte of any drive here. The Crucial X10 Pro sits second because doubling to 2,100MB/s costs about 20% more, which is the cleanest speed-per-dollar step on this list. The Samsung T9 is third and earns it on the one specification nobody publishes: it stays above 1,500MB/s after the SLC cache fills, while most drives here collapse to a third of their headline number on a long transfer.

On timing, I will give a direct answer. If you need the capacity, buy now. Consumer NAND fell from 45% of total output in 2024 to 32% in 2026 because wafer capacity moved to AI server parts, and that is a production allocation decision with multi-quarter lead times. TrendForce projects a further 10-15% contract price rise in Q3. Waiting for a sale is a losing trade when discounts run smaller than the monthly drift. If you can free up space on what you already own, do that first and revisit in 2027.

One old rule is now dead. Buying one capacity tier up used to lower your cost per terabyte reliably. In 2026 the large capacities absorbed the steepest increases, which flattens that curve and sometimes inverts it. Check the per-terabyte math on the exact two capacities in front of you before you reach for the bigger one.

highlights.title: The Crucial X9 Pro wins because cost per terabyte is the only column that matters in 2026
highlights.body: The X9 Pro delivers about 1,050MB/s and holds it through a full 200GB write, which covers a card dump, a Lightroom catalogue and a game library equally well. It carries a steel body rated for a 7.5-foot drop, which is the toughest shell in the sub-$200 tier. When NAND costs have roughly doubled inside twelve months, the drive that gives you working speed at the lowest dollars per terabyte is the correct default, and that is the X9 Pro by a comfortable margin.

highlights.title: Sustained write after the SLC cache fills is the specification that decides whether a drive is worth owning
highlights.body: Manufacturers quote peak speeds measured inside the SLC cache, which is a burst of a few dozen gigabytes at most. Dump a 200GB card and the cache runs dry, at which point many drives drop to a third of their advertised figure. The Samsung T9 holds above 1,500MB/s through that entire transfer, and the Corsair EX400U settles around 1,600 to 1,700MB/s. That is the number a video editor feels on deadline, and it appears on no spec sheet anywhere. I score it heavily here because it is the single largest gap between marketing and daily use in this category.

highlights.title: Buy now if you actually need the capacity, because waiting has no payoff before 2027
highlights.body: Consumer NAND dropped from 45% of production in 2024 to 32% in 2026 as wafer capacity shifted toward AI server storage. That is an allocation decision with multi-quarter lead times, and industry consensus has moved from relief by year-end to no meaningful relief until 2027. TrendForce expects contract prices to climb another 10-15% in Q3. Holding out for Black Friday is a losing bet when the discount is smaller than the drift between now and then. If you can delete or archive your way out of the purchase, do that and revisit next year. If you cannot, today is cheaper than December.

highlights.title: USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 is a compatibility trap on a Mac and buyers keep walking into it
highlights.body: The Samsung T9, Crucial X10 Pro and Kingston XS2000 reach 2,000MB/s only on a USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 host port. Apple never implemented Gen 2x2, so on any Mac those drives run at Gen 2 speeds, roughly 1,000MB/s, and you paid for headroom you will never see. Mac owners who want the full number need a USB4 or Thunderbolt drive, which is where the Corsair EX400U and the SanDisk Extreme PRO V3 earn their price. Check your host port before your drive, because the port sets the ceiling and no firmware update will raise it.

highlights.title: The buy-a-bigger-capacity rule stopped working this year
highlights.body: For a decade the reliable advice was that stepping up one capacity tier lowered your cost per terabyte, so you bought more than you needed. The 2026 price surge hit high capacities hardest, which flattens that curve and in some product lines reverses it. Samsung T-series pricing currently runs $225 to $268 per terabyte at 1TB and around $200 per terabyte at 4TB, a much thinner gap than the 40% spread that used to be routine. The WD Black SN8100 8TB crossing $2,500 is the extreme version of the same effect. Run the division on the two capacities you are choosing between rather than assuming the larger one wins.

zh-tw.commentary:
外接 SSD 這種東西我排了很多年，一直都是拿循序讀取速度當第一欄。今年不能這樣排了，因為速度是固定的，價格每個禮拜都在動，所以我把整份榜單重寫成以每 TB 單價排序，而且每個數字都標日期。

說真的，背後的數字看了會有點傻眼。1Tb TLC NAND 顆粒 2025 年 7 月大概 4.8 美元，現在要 10.7 美元左右。2TB NVMe 硬碟 2025 年 11 月賣 175 美元，2026 年 3 月變成 379 美元。SanDisk 全線調價，部分型號漲到 2.8 倍。Samsung T9 1TB 上市定價 139.99 美元，現在成交價落在 245 美元附近。同一台機器、同一版韌體、同一個盒子，價格變成 1.75 倍。

所以第一名是 Crucial X9 Pro，理由是算出來的。它連續寫入 200GB 全程都在 1,050MB/s 左右，鋁合金機身撐得住兩公尺多的落摔，而每 TB 單價是這份榜單裡最低的，台灣通路 1TB 大概五千有找。第二名 Crucial X10 Pro，速度翻倍到 2,100MB/s 只多付兩成價錢，這是整份榜單裡最划算的一次升級。第三名 Samsung T9 贏在一個規格表上永遠找不到的數字，SLC 快取寫滿之後它還守得住 1,500MB/s 以上，而這裡多數機種在長時間傳輸時會掉到標示速度的三分之一。

至於現在該不該買，我直接給結論。真的需要容量就現在買。消費級 NAND 產能佔比從 2024 年的 45% 掉到 2026 年的 32%，因為晶圓產能被 AI 伺服器吃走了，這是產能配置層級的決策，前置期以季為單位。TrendForce 推估第三季合約價還要再漲一到一成五。等特價這件事在今年是穩賠的，因為折扣幅度小於漲價速度，等到雙十一你反而付更多。手上還有空間可以清的人，先清，明年再回頭看。

另外有一條老規矩今年失效了。以前買大一階容量一定比較划算，這條在 2026 年不成立，因為大容量的漲幅遠高於小容量，那條每 TB 遞減曲線被壓平了。站在架上要決定買 1TB 還是 2TB 的時候，把兩個價格各自除以容量算一次，不要直接假設買大的比較賺。

highlights.title: Crucial X9 Pro 拿第一，因為 2026 年只剩每 TB 單價這一欄有意義
highlights.body: X9 Pro 給你 1,050MB/s，而且連續寫 200GB 全程守得住，倒記憶卡、搬 Lightroom 圖庫、放 Steam 遊戲庫都夠用。鋁合金機身撐得住兩公尺多的落摔，是六千元以下這一段最耐操的殼。在 NAND 顆粒一年內漲快一倍的環境下，能用最低每 TB 單價換到堪用速度的那一台就是正解，X9 Pro 領先幅度還不小，台灣通路 1TB 大概五千塊上下，是這份榜單裡最好入手的價位。

highlights.title: SLC 快取寫滿之後的持續寫入，才是決定一台硬碟值不值得買的規格
highlights.body: 廠商標的峰值速度是在 SLC 快取內量的，那個快取通常只有幾十 GB。你倒一張 200GB 的記憶卡，快取一寫滿，很多機種直接掉到標示速度的三分之一。Samsung T9 整趟傳輸都守在 1,500MB/s 以上，Corsair EX400U 快取寫滿後穩在 1,600 到 1,700MB/s。這個數字是剪接師趕稿時真正會有感的東西，可是全世界沒有一張規格表會寫。我在這份榜單給它很高的權重，因為它是這個品類裡行銷數字跟實際體驗落差最大的地方。

highlights.title: 真的需要容量就現在買，等到 2027 年以前等待都沒有回報
highlights.body: 消費級 NAND 從 2024 年佔總產能 45% 掉到 2026 年的 32%，晶圓產能被 AI 伺服器儲存吃走了。這種產能配置的調整前置期是好幾季，產業共識已經從年底緩解修正成 2027 年才會有實質緩解。TrendForce 推估第三季合約價還要再漲一到一成五。想撐到雙十一或黑五的人要想清楚，折扣幅度打不過這段期間的漲幅，等下去只是付更多。手上硬碟還有東西可以清、可以搬去 NAS 的，那就先清，明年再說。真的清不出來的，今天買就是比十二月便宜。

highlights.title: USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 在 Mac 上是個相容性陷阱，很多人買了才發現
highlights.body: Samsung T9、Crucial X10 Pro 跟 Kingston XS2000 要跑到 2,000MB/s，主機端必須是 USB 3.2 Gen 2x2。Apple 從來沒有支援過 Gen 2x2，所以這三台插上任何一台 Mac 都只跑 Gen 2 的一千出頭，你多付的那筆錢一輩子看不到。用 Mac 又想吃到完整速度的人要選 USB4 或 Thunderbolt 機種，Corsair EX400U 跟 SanDisk Extreme PRO V3 的價差就是花在這裡。先確認自己的孔，再挑硬碟，因為天花板是主機端訂的，韌體更新救不了。

highlights.title: 買大一階容量比較划算，這條規矩今年不成立了
highlights.body: 過去十年的通則是往上買一階容量，每 TB 單價會下降，所以大家都買超過自己需要的容量。2026 年這波漲價對大容量下手最重，那條遞減曲線被壓平，某些產品線甚至反轉。Samsung T 系列目前 1TB 的每 TB 單價落在 225 到 268 美元，4TB 大概 200 美元，價差遠小於過去常見的四成。WD Black SN8100 8TB 突破 2,500 美元是同一件事的極端版本，一顆硬碟貴過一台不錯的電競桌機。站在架上猶豫 1TB 還 2TB 的時候，兩邊各除一次，算完再決定。

en.commentary:
The Crucial X9 Pro holds first place and price per terabyte is why. A 9.5 price per TB score is the highest among drives with genuinely good performance, and for a portable SSD the capacity you can afford determines whether it holds a project or an entire archive. The 9.0 portability score describes a drive small enough to live in a laptop sleeve permanently.

The Crucial X10 Pro at number two steps up the interface to 9.0 and the sustained write to 8.8, which matters when you are offloading a full card of 4K footage rather than copying documents.

The Samsung T9 at number three has the best sustained write performance in this ranking at 9.6. For video editors working directly off the drive, that consistency prevents the dropouts that happen when a cache fills mid-transfer.

The SanDisk Extreme Portable at number four carries a 9.2 durability score with IP65 rating, and for anyone working outdoors that protection is worth the modest performance trade.

No changes this week. NAND pricing has been stable through August.

highlights.title: Price per terabyte decides how useful a portable drive is
highlights.body: A 9.5 price per TB score on the X9 Pro means you can buy 2TB or 4TB instead of settling for 1TB. A portable SSD that fills up after two shoots interrupts your workflow constantly. Buying enough capacity the first time is the decision that makes the drive genuinely useful.

highlights.title: Sustained write is the number video work depends on
highlights.body: The Samsung T9 scores 9.6 on sustained write, and that describes performance after the cache fills. Peak speeds look impressive in a benchmark and mean little when you are copying 200GB of footage. Consistent write throughput is what prevents a transfer from crawling halfway through.

highlights.title: SanDisk Extreme Portable is the drive for field work
highlights.body: A 9.2 durability score with IP65 rating covers dust and water spray, which is what a drive faces on a location shoot or a hiking trip. The performance sits below the fastest options here, and for footage you cannot reshoot, physical protection is the more valuable specification.

zh-tw.commentary:
Crucial X9 Pro 守住第一，理由是每 TB 的價格。

9.5 分的每 TB 價格在效能真的夠好的硬碟裡是最高的，而對一顆外接 SSD 來說，你買得起多少容量直接決定它裝得下一個專案還是整個素材庫。9.0 分的便攜性描述的是一顆小到可以長期住在筆電內袋的硬碟。

第二名 Crucial X10 Pro 把介面拉到 9.0 分、持續寫入拉到 8.8 分，當你在倒一整張 4K 素材卡而不是複製文件時，這件事就很有感。

第三名 Samsung T9 的持續寫入 9.6 分是全榜最高。影片剪輯師直接在硬碟上工作的話，這種穩定度可以避免快取寫滿之後傳輸中斷的狀況。

第四名 SanDisk Extreme Portable 有 9.2 分耐用度跟 IP65 防護，要在戶外工作的人，這層保護值得用一點效能去換。

這週不動。八月 NAND 價格很穩定。

highlights.title: 每 TB 多少錢，決定一顆外接硬碟有多好用
highlights.body: X9 Pro 的 9.5 分每 TB 價格代表你可以買 2TB 或 4TB，而不是勉強收 1TB。一顆拍兩場就滿的外接 SSD 會不斷打斷你的工作流程。第一次就買足容量，才是讓這顆硬碟真的好用的決定。

highlights.title: 影片工作靠的是持續寫入這個數字
highlights.body: Samsung T9 的持續寫入 9.6 分，描述的是快取寫滿之後的表現。峰值速度在跑分軟體裡很好看，你在複製 200GB 素材的時候它沒什麼意義。穩定的寫入吞吐量，才是讓傳輸不會做到一半開始爬的關鍵。

highlights.title: 外景工作就用 SanDisk Extreme Portable
highlights.body: 9.2 分耐用度加 IP65 防護，涵蓋灰塵跟潑水，這正是外景拍攝或登山時硬碟會遇到的狀況。它的效能不是這裡最快的，而對於補拍不回來的素材來說，實體保護是更值錢的規格。

en.commentary: The Crucial X9 Pro stays at number one with 9.0, and the reason has more to do with honesty than peak numbers. Portable SSD marketing quotes burst speeds that a drive holds for a few seconds before the cache fills and throughput collapses. The X9 Pro sustains its rated write speed through large transfers, which is the number that matters when you dump a card full of 4K footage or clone a project folder. Price per terabyte also remains excellent, and it comes with a five-year warranty. The Crucial X10 Pro at 8.8 is the faster drive on the interface and costs more per terabyte, so it earns its place with people who genuinely saturate USB 3.2 Gen 2x2. The Samsung T9 at 8.7 has the most robust build and the best software, and Samsung's track record on firmware support is the best in the category, which matters for a device holding your only copy of something. The SanDisk Extreme Portable at 8.4 is the rugged pick with an IP65 rating for field work. Lower down, the value drives at 7.2 to 7.9 are fine for backups and cold storage, and I would keep working files on something with sustained write performance.

highlights.title: Sustained write speed is the only number worth checking
highlights.body: Every drive quotes a burst figure it holds until the cache fills, sometimes for less than ten seconds. The X9 Pro maintains its rated write through a full card offload, which is the difference between a five-minute transfer and a twenty-minute one. That consistency plus a strong price per terabyte is what keeps it at 9.0.

highlights.title: Samsung's firmware track record matters more than people think
highlights.body: A portable SSD often holds the only copy of footage between a shoot and an edit. Samsung has the strongest history of shipping firmware fixes for its drives, and the T9's magnesium shell handles being thrown in a bag. At 8.7 you pay a little more per terabyte for peace of mind that has real value.

highlights.title: Budget drives belong in backup duty, not working duty
highlights.body: The drives at the bottom of this list are genuinely fine for archives and cold storage where you write once and read occasionally. Working files deserve sustained write performance, because a drive that collapses to hard-drive speeds mid-transfer turns a quick offload into a coffee break. Split your money accordingly.

zh-tw.commentary:
Crucial X9 Pro 守住第一 9.0，理由跟峰值數字關係不大，跟誠實比較有關。

外接 SSD 的行銷都在寫爆發速度，那個數字撐個幾秒鐘、快取一滿就崩掉。X9 Pro 在大檔傳輸中維持得住標稱寫入速度，你把一張塞滿 4K 素材的記憶卡倒進去、或整包專案資料夾複製過去的時候，看的就是這個數字。每 TB 價格也漂亮，還有五年保固。

Crucial X10 Pro 8.8 介面速度更快、每 TB 更貴，適合真的能把 USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 跑滿的人。

Samsung T9 8.7 做工最扎實、軟體最好，三星的韌體更新紀錄是全類別最可靠的。一台裝著你唯一一份檔案的裝置，這件事很重要。

SanDisk Extreme Portable 8.4 是外拍首選，IP65 防護撐得住現場環境。

再往下 7.2 到 7.9 那幾顆拿來備份跟冷資料完全沒問題，工作中的檔案我還是會放在持續寫入穩的那幾顆上。

highlights.title: 唯一值得看的數字是持續寫入速度
highlights.body: 每一顆都會標一個爆發速度，那是快取滿之前的數字，有時候撐不到十秒。X9 Pro 把整張卡倒完的過程中都維持得住標稱寫入，這是五分鐘傳完跟二十分鐘傳完的差別。這種穩定度加上每 TB 的好價格，9.0 分它站得住。

highlights.title: 三星的韌體更新紀錄比大家想的重要
highlights.body: 外接 SSD 常常是拍攝到剪輯之間唯一一份檔案的所在地。三星在替自家硬碟推韌體修正這件事上紀錄最好，T9 的鎂合金外殼也禁得起被丟進包包。8.7 分，每 TB 貴一點點，換的是有實質價值的安心。

highlights.title: 便宜的碟拿去備份，不要拿來當工作碟
highlights.body: 榜單後段那幾顆做封存跟冷資料完全夠用，寫一次、偶爾讀一下。工作中的檔案值得配持續寫入穩的碟，因為傳到一半掉到傳統硬碟速度，快速倒檔就變成喝咖啡時間。錢照這個邏輯分配就對了。

en.commentary: The Crucial X9 Pro holds first because it delivers the best price per terabyte among drives that sustain their write speed under load, and sustained write is where cheap portable SSDs collapse. A drive that starts at a thousand megabytes per second and drops to two hundred after thirty seconds is useless for video work, and the X9 Pro holds its speed. Crucial X10 Pro at 8.8 is faster and costs more per terabyte, which suits anyone whose workflow is genuinely bottlenecked by transfer speed. Samsung T9 at 8.7 has the longest track record for reliability, and for archival storage that history is worth paying for. SanDisk Extreme Portable at 8.4 is the rugged option and it survives field use. Corsair EX400U at 8.3 offers strong performance. My practical guidance: a portable SSD is working storage rather than a backup, since a single drive holds a single copy and any drive can fail. Keep three copies of anything you cannot recreate, on two different media, with one stored elsewhere. Check the warranty terms too, because coverage varies from three to five years across this list.

highlights.title: Sustained write is where cheap drives collapse
highlights.body: A drive that starts fast and drops to two hundred megabytes per second after thirty seconds is useless for video. The Crucial X9 Pro holds its speed under load, which is why it leads on real-world usefulness.

highlights.title: Samsung's reliability record is worth paying for
highlights.body: The T9 has the longest proven track record in this category. For archival storage where a failure means losing data you cannot recreate, that history justifies a higher price per terabyte.

highlights.title: Rugged matters for field work
highlights.body: The SanDisk Extreme Portable survives drops and weather that would end a standard enclosure. For anyone shooting on location, that durability outweighs a small advantage in transfer speed.

highlights.title: A single drive is not a backup
highlights.body: One drive holds one copy, and any drive can fail without warning. Keep three copies of irreplaceable data on two different media with one stored elsewhere, because portable SSDs are working storage.

zh-tw.commentary:
Crucial X9 Pro 守第一，因為在「持續寫入撐得住」的那批硬碟裡，它的每 TB 價格最好。而持續寫入速度正是便宜外接 SSD 崩掉的地方。一顆開頭跑一千 MB/s、三十秒後掉到兩百的硬碟，剪片根本不能用，而 X9 Pro 守得住速度。

Crucial X10 Pro 8.8 更快、每 TB 也更貴，適合工作流真的卡在傳輸速度上的人。

Samsung T9 8.7 的可靠度紀錄最長，做封存儲存的話，這份歷史是值得付錢的。SanDisk Extreme Portable 8.4 是三防款，外拍現場撐得住。Corsair EX400U 8.3 效能扎實。

實用建議：外接 SSD 是工作碟，不是備份。一顆硬碟就是一份副本，而任何硬碟都可能故障。任何你重建不了的資料，請保三份副本、放在兩種不同媒體上、其中一份存在別的地方。另外也看一下保固條款，這份榜單裡從三年到五年都有。

highlights.title: 便宜硬碟就是崩在持續寫入
highlights.body: 開頭很快、三十秒後掉到兩百 MB/s 的硬碟，剪片完全不能用。Crucial X9 Pro 在負載下守得住速度，實用性上的領先就在這裡。

highlights.title: Samsung 的可靠度紀錄值得付錢
highlights.body: T9 在這個品類的實證紀錄最長。做封存用途、故障就等於失去無法重建的資料時，這份歷史撐得起較高的每 TB 價格。

highlights.title: 外拍現場需要三防
highlights.body: SanDisk Extreme Portable 撐得住摔落跟天候，那些狀況會直接終結一般外接盒。在外景拍攝的人，這份耐用勝過一點點傳輸速度優勢。

highlights.title: 一顆硬碟不是備份
highlights.body: 一顆硬碟就是一份副本，而任何硬碟都可能無預警故障。重建不了的資料請保三份、放兩種媒體、其中一份異地存放，外接 SSD 是工作碟。

en.commentary:
The ranking is unchanged this week and the market underneath it is anything but. TLC 1-terabit NAND has doubled in six months, from 4.80 dollars to 10.70, and contract prices have multiplied roughly 4.2 to 4.5 times across the last three quarters. A 2TB NVMe drive that sold for 120 to 150 dollars a year ago now asks 300 to 480. Industry consensus has moved the first meaningful consumer relief out to 2027.

That reframes what a price-per-terabyte score means. Crucial X9 Pro keeps first at 9.0 because its 9.5 on price per terabyte is measured against today's inflated field, and because it holds sustained write under load, which is exactly where cheap drives collapse. A drive that starts at a thousand megabytes per second and drops to two hundred after thirty seconds is useless for video work.

Crucial X10 Pro at 8.8 is the faster option and the one to buy when transfer speed genuinely bottlenecks the workflow. Samsung T9 at 8.7 has the longest reliability record here, and for archival storage that history justifies the premium per terabyte.

SanDisk Extreme Portable at 8.4 survives field use with a 9.2 durability score. Corsair EX400U at 8.3 posts the best interface score at 9.6 on USB4, which is the one to watch as more laptops ship the port.

Concrete advice for this market: buy the capacity you need now rather than the capacity you will want in a year. Waiting has cost buyers money every single month of 2026.

highlights.body: Industry consensus has pushed the first meaningful consumer price drop out a year. Buy the capacity you need now, because waiting has cost money every month of 2026.

這會改寫「每 TB 價格」這個分數的意義。Crucial X9 Pro 守第一 9.0 分，因為它 9.5 的每 TB 價格是拿今天這個膨脹過的市場當基準，而且負載下守得住持續寫入。一顆開頭跑一千 MB/s、三十秒後掉到兩百的硬碟，剪片根本不能用。

Crucial X10 Pro 8.8 分更快，工作流真的卡在傳輸速度就買它。Samsung T9 8.7 分的可靠度紀錄最長，封存用途撐得起較高單價。Corsair EX400U 8.3 分的 USB4 介面 9.6 是全榜最好。

這個行情下的實話：現在需要多大就買多大，2026 年每等一個月都在多花錢。
